note: Chapter 21 (Trigonometry) runs book pp.676-690 for its 273 questions (organised by the book's own Type A-Y labels: maxima/minima, basic identities, complementary angles, componendo, quadrant, angle-solving, radian/degree, and more), plus a further ~20 pages of worked solutions (pp.691-713) used only as a bonus cross-check, not mined for new questions. This is an identity-heavy chapter with enormous repetition - most of the 273 are the same handful of techniques with different numbers - so a representative slice was filed rather than anywhere near all 273: 21 questions across 7 new qtypes (q-tr-max-linear, q-tr-max-amgm, q-tr-bound-trick, q-tr-identity-simplify, q-tr-complement-telescope, q-tr-complement-sumsq, q-tr-componendo, q-tr-power-sum-trap, q-tr-equation-solve - one extra beyond 7 since componendo split into two), plus 2 more filed into the pre-existing q-tr-triangle qtype. Every answer was independently recomputed (numerically, not just by the book's own working) and also checked against the book's printed answer key (pp.689-690), which every one of these matched exactly.
